findings.detail: X04 is firing on rows whose source Reference Rate and Spread cells explicitly contain S plus a spread, so the basis_spread values are source-supported.

rationale: The X04 issue says fixed coupon rows should not carry basis_spread, but the raw schedule rows with the disputed spread values disclose floating reference-rate terms in the Reference Rate and Spread column. Thrasio discloses S + 10.00% PIK, Streamland discloses S + 6.50% including PIK, and Sweep Purchaser discloses S + 5.75% PIK. The stored basis_spread values therefore match source terms; the check/classification treating these rows as fixed-rate-only is the defect.
